requirements.text: Implement durable planning row-resolution evidence and validation checks for accepted decision rows/downstream questions.
Fail or block planning validation when decision-to-roadmap propagation is incomplete, requiring superseding planning builds before implementation.
Expose residual accepted-decision propagation gaps in graph/status/audit and route roadmap-empty/task-close contexts back to planning.

assumptions: TASK-011 is a single atomic process-gate implementation task; it does not migrate source files or build UI surfaces.
The row-resolution model can be additive/backward-compatible for existing builds.
The implementation can initially treat legacy builds without row-resolution fields through deterministic inference and warning/fail policy based on profile/risk.
open_questions: Exact field name for durable row-resolution evidence is implementation detail; candidate names include row_resolution, propagation_map, or decision_row_mappings.
risks: Strict enforcement could flag historical accepted decisions; implementation should define legacy/current policy carefully.
False positives are likely unless knowledge-only and explicit deferred states are modeled clearly.
